production.reason: Accepted-head and private-request bundles share cache publication, bounded Git execution, standalone verification, and download streaming; operation supervision and tests are separate modules.
Discussion queries and mutations share visibility projection, cursor, anchor, and response mapping rules.

Existing list, queue, lifecycle and start endpoints share HTTP input and response translation; dependency policy lives in scope-domain, metadata reads in scope-postgres and the paged children handler in its own module.

Upload, processing, binding, access, and media-manifest rules share source, derivative, and quota invariants; keeping these pure rules together preserves one policy owner independent of persistence and delivery.
Tree construction, native-range validation, deterministic object identity, and identity fixtures are one algorithm.
Discussion and reply mutations, visibility, read state, attachment binding, and notifications share the same request discussion transaction boundary.

Photo and video conversion share verified codec capabilities, output inspection, bounded subprocess policy, and failure classification; container and source inspection are already isolated in codec/inspection.
